enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Acidic 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with acid, dealing 7d6 Acid damage on each hit.
Corroding 16: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with acid, dealing 16d6 Acid damage on each critical hit.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +7d8 damage.
Dragon's Edge 7: +23% Enhancement bonus to bypass enemy Fortification. On Crit: 7d8 Bleeding Damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
